description: Integration tests, E2E test with realistic scan flow, test fixtures, and comprehensive documentation for the event-driven engine architecture.
steps: Create tests/integration/__init__.py and tests/integration/test_orchestrator_flow.py - Integration tests covering: adapter with mocked execution producing events, orchestrator with in-memory SQLite DB processing a full discovery->enrichment flow, event flow from EntityDiscovered to PendingKeyCreated to PendingKeyResolved to downstream ToolSelected, parallel scheduling logic (verify concurrency limits respected), retry and timeout handling (mock a failing tool, verify retry with backoff).

Create tests/integration/test_pending_keys.py - Integration tests for pending key lifecycle: create pending key when tool discovers new subdomain, resolve pending key when live_host confirmed, trigger downstream tool (e.g. nuclei) only when live_host key resolved, prevent duplicate tool runs via fingerprint check, verify blocked tools remain blocked when dependencies missing.

Create tests/e2e/__init__.py and tests/e2e/test_full_scan.py - E2E test that runs a realistic scan flow: seed domain -> passive discovery (mocked crtsh returning subdomains) -> entities persisted in DB -> pending keys created for live_host -> DNS resolve (mocked) confirms some hosts live -> pending keys resolved -> downstream tools triggered -> verify final DB state has correct assets, no duplicates, correct confidence scores, audit trail present. Uses respx to mock HTTP calls and a temporary SQLite DB.

Create tests/fixtures/ directory with sample data files: tests/fixtures/crtsh_response.json (sample CT log response), tests/fixtures/subfinder_stdout.txt (sample CLI output), tests/fixtures/nuclei_jsonl.txt (sample JSONL findings), tests/fixtures/httpx_probe.json (sample probe results), tests/fixtures/malformed_output.txt (garbage/partial), tests/fixtures/empty_response.json. These serve as regression fixtures for parser testing.

Create docs/engine/ directory with architecture documentation: docs/engine/00-architecture-overview.md (high-level diagram of event-driven engine, components, data flow), docs/engine/01-event-flow.md (all events, when they fire, who handles them), docs/engine/02-tool-registry.md (schema reference, how to add tools), docs/engine/03-adapter-contract.md (all methods, when to implement each, reference implementation), docs/engine/04-pending-keys.md (lifecycle, rules, examples), docs/engine/05-parallel-execution.md (concurrency model, safety rules, configuration), docs/engine/06-incremental-scans.md (fingerprinting, staleness, delta reprocessing), docs/engine/07-ai-decisioning.md (interface, heuristics, mocking), docs/engine/08-observability.md (logging format, metrics, correlation IDs), docs/engine/09-adding-new-adapter.md (step-by-step guide with examples), docs/engine/10-troubleshooting.md (common issues, debugging, FAQ).
Update the main README.md to add a section about the event-driven engine architecture, linking to docs/engine/ and explaining the relationship to the existing phased pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests verify event flow from discovery through persistence
Integration tests verify pending key creation and resolution
Integration tests verify parallel scheduling respects concurrency limits
E2E test runs a complete scan flow and verifies DB state
E2E test confirms no duplicate entities are created
E2E test confirms blocked tools remain blocked
Test fixtures exist for all major output formats
README updated with engine architecture section
findings: All 222 tests pass (20 new tests added). Ruff clean on new files. Pre-existing lint issues in recontool/adapters/active.py, inventory/, and tests/atomic/ are unchanged.
